listing.name: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas: Oogie's Revenge — Oogie's Revenge Recomp (josiahg2502-glitch)
listing.original_game_title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas: Oogie's Revenge
listing.summary: The project reports a playable opening at 60 FPS and 4K. Translating the whole executable does not establish that the whole game works. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas: Oogie's Revenge Original Xbox disc ISO or extracted full disc files. USA original-Original Xbox title 42560004; setup validates default.xbe SHA256, exact value not captured.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run the project’s PowerShell build with your own USA Oogie’s Revenge ISO, XISO or extracted folder. It downloads the pinned tools and compiles locally.

warnings: The project reports a playable opening at 60 FPS and 4K. Translating the whole executable does not establish that the whole game works.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
